svg.title: Vartti Blend B system architecture
svg.desc: Inputs, LightGBM and neural forecasting, fusion, validation, and dashboard.

g.text: 10-Hour Ahead Probabilistic Electricity Imbalance Price Forecasting (40 × 15-min Horizons)
Fingrid Regulation Rules · Equal 50/50 Quantile & Probability Ensemble · Publication-Time Input Checks
mFRR/aFRR prices & act., power gen, 397 net imbalance
Published before the issue time for all 40 steps
SE1, SE3, EE imbalance prices & load schedules (1-hop)
FMI obs + OL3/Loviisa versioned as-of timestamps
At forecast origin t: use row if and only if first_usable_origin_utc ≤ t
Training label cutoff · Automated future-perturbation check
• Historical pre-June dual-extreme prices re-calculated to
the post-June rule where component inputs are available
• Adds regime_pre_june indicator flag to preserve transition
✓ Gains on all 4 validation folds: MAE 42.69 → 41.92
Captures system stress & under-generation ramp bias
Identical (origin, step) samples streamed to both GBDT & Neural Nets
• Objective: alpha-pinball loss on imbalance spread
• HP: depth 5, 24 leaves, min 200/leaf, lr 0.04, 200 rounds
Post-sorts raw quantile predictions along axis=1.
• Softmax output aligned with market dispatch direction
• CDF evaluated at both spread thresholds
• Blend B uses the quantile CDF for its LightGBM half
Fitted on the last 14 days before cutoff across 3 distinct lead-time horizon bands:
• Concurrent ThreadPoolExecutor trains 21 independent models across CPU cores (releases GIL)
• Training duration depends on hardware and thread settings
• Tree SHAP marginal contributions calculated on P50 spread model (last_spread, spot_level, net_load)
Output: Spread Quantiles (19) · Directions (3) · Spike Probs (2) · SHAP Drivers (top 3)
STREAM B: Neural ensemble (50% blend weight)
Median/IQR Robust scale + Dual Channels: Bounded Linear Clip(z/3, -2, 2) + Heavy-Tail asinh(z)/3 + Harmonic Sin/Cos bases
• Fourier Periodic Feature Embeddings (Gorishniy et al.)
• Covariate projection: 40 dynamic step features jointly encoded
• Dense Encoder-Decoder with temporal step embeddings
• Directly links origin imbalance stress to entire delivery path
Epoch: 9 · Val MAE: 41.45 (Best Single DL Model)
• Multi-Scale 1D Conv (k=3, 5) extracts spot slope & curvature
• FiLM feature modulation conditioned on origin imbalance
• 2-layer Bidirectional GRU propagates forward & backward trends
Epoch: 7 · Captures sudden morning/evening price ramps
• 4-Expert Shared Mixture-of-Experts with soft regime router
• Learns routing weights jointly with the experts
• Median is unconstrained: q_50 = Linear(h) + Highway(x)
• Higher quantiles: q[k] = q[k-1] + Softplus(delta_k) + 1e-4 | Lower: q[j] = q[j+1] - Softplus(delta_j) - 1e-4
✓ Guarantees q_05 ≤ ... ≤ q_50 ≤ ... ≤ q_95 identically by construction (AQCR = 0%)
• Pass 1 calibrates on a 14-day training holdout; pass 2 refits through the cutoff
• Three training seeds per architecture with an exponential moving average of weights
• Equal-weight (0.25 × 4) produces pure DL Ensemble prediction + gradient saliency for driver attribution
• GBDT brings sharp step-level partition & tail robustness
• DL brings 40-step trajectory coherence & cross-covariate context
• Validation compares the blend with each model family
P_imbalance(t, s) = Spot(t, s) + Spread(t, s)
• The published day-ahead curve supplies the spot baseline
• Spot anchoring lets both models estimate the spread
instead of learning the full price level directly
Borda count rank-merging with tie-break toward Tree SHAP
Exported to backtest CSV 'top_drivers' column for judges
The original submission passed the validator.
Separates high (+50 €) and low (-50 €) spike chances
Reliable up / down settlement direction tracking
BLEND B IMPROVED ALL FOUR VALIDATION LOSSES
Comparison against persistence on the validation window
• Alert triggered when hourly mean spike prob reaches 20%
• 70% of exceptional episodes flagged in advance
• Median lead time: 9 hours · Hourly F1 score: 0.48
Review boiler dispatch during negative-price periods
Review storage plans ahead of high-price risk
Review positions when upper-tail risk rises
• Historical dial scrubber: replay forecasts as-of any past hour
• Significant revision alerts (> 12 pp spike prob or 22 €/MWh shift)
• Low confidence flags on data latency or wide P10-P90 spreads
| Target: Finnish Imbalance Price (15-min) | Horizon: 10h (40 steps) | Model: Blend B (50% LightGBM + 50% DL Ensemble)
